_README: Hand-entered coordinates. Wins over every other source in geocode.mjs.
Shape: "facility-slug": { lat, lon, precision: "manual", source: "how you found it" }
These exist because Nominatim resolved the facility only to its town.
Each `source` records the evidence, so a later reader can check the work
rather than trusting the number. Entries where no defensible evidence was
found are deliberately ABSENT — they stay flagged as city_centroid by
validate.mjs instead of being quietly guessed at. Currently unresolved:
serket-golf-club (nothing named Serket within 9km of Henderson — likely a
rebrand) and the-links-golf-club (not in OSM under that name near Marlton).

rancho-park-golf-club.source: Nominatim leisure=golf_course 'Rancho Park Golf Course, 10460 West Pico Boulevard, Cheviot Hills'. Nominatim's default result put this on the downtown LA centroid, ~14km east — worth fixing because it is the most-played course on the list.

kukio-makai-beach-golf-club.source: Nominatim leisure=resort 'Kukio Golf and Beach Club, Kukio Nui Drive, Hawaii County'. Grint files it as 'Kukio Makai Beach Golf Club'.

manhattan-country-club.source: Overpass way/192168936, leisure=golf_course, name='Westdrift Golf'. Grint's row is 'Westdrift | Manhattan Country Club', so the match is on the layout name — the OSM name and the Grint facility name never overlap, which is why the automatic matcher missed it.

tierra-rejada-golf-club.source: Overpass way/1454217169, leisure=golf_course, tagged name='Golf Development Complex' — the only golf polygon on Tierra Rejada Rd, Moorpark. INFERRED from location, not confirmed by name; good enough for a pin, not a fact. Worth fixing because this is the 2nd most-played course on the list (8 rounds).

lanier-islands-golf-course.source: Centre of a cluster of four unnamed leisure=golf_course ways (way/34773053, /34773055, /34773062, /34773064) on Lake Lanier Islands, Buford GA. INFERRED: the polygons are unnamed in OSM, but Lake Lanier Islands has one golf course and this is it.
